data.one_liner: Flutter golden testing helper with declarative API
data.what_it_does: Alchemist provides a declarative API for writing and running golden tests in Flutter. It supports platform and CI tests, automatic sizing, theme customization, and custom text scaling.
use_when: Writing golden tests for Flutter widgets
Running platform or CI golden tests that need consistent output across environments
Customizing golden test appearance with themes or text scale factors
avoid_when: You only need basic widget tests without image comparison
Your project does not use Flutter or does not require golden testing
strengths: Built-in support for platform vs CI tests with Ahem font
Automatic image sizing and theme customization
100% test coverage of the package itself
weaknesses: Only supports golden testing, not other test types
